title: chore: define the Wave 1 sha and revision shape checks and renderGot once
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate (task-808869c5). There is no drift today: every copy agrees. But the task-9e851d4e reopen showed how a consumer copy drifts from its producer.
- SHA 7-40 hex: candidateStore.SHA_RE (exported), plus copies in checkRunStore (SHA_RE) and tools/recordCommit.ts (SHA_RE).
- 40-hex revision: receiptStore REVISION_RE, finalizeAttempt REVISION_PATTERN, and deliveryProjection's inline isLandedRevision regex.
- renderGot: 5 byte-identical copies, in delivery/policy.ts, candidateStore, checkRunStore, receiptStore and reviewStore.
- Stale text: CLAUDE.md says NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT counts commits "since reviewStartedAt". The rule has been the work round (latest rejection, else first step start, else reviewStartedAt) since aae0067. task-808869c5 fixed docs/MCP_SERVER.md and docs/CONFIGURATION.md; CLAUDE.md was carrying a peer's work at the time.
definitionOfDone: Each shape rule and renderGot is defined once and imported everywhere it is checked; exported-symbol allowlist tests are updated
No behaviour change: the full daemon suite passes unchanged, with the same counts
CLAUDE.md's NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT anchor matches delivery/policy.ts completionCommitsForReview

1. Is there any import cycle? Name each new import edge and say why it is acyclic. stateModules.test.ts must stay green.
2. Is each regex byte-for-byte the same language as every copy it replaced? The /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/i form counts as the same language as /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.

6. Were no tests added or removed? Only candidateStore.test.ts changed.
7. Is the CLAUDE.md hunk exactly the one clause?
8. Run 'git diff --stat': only the 10 planned paths are this task's.

comments.author: qa-7100be29
comments.content:
QA of task-808869c5 adds one input for the shared shape rule: SHA-256 object-format repositories.

Every Wave 1 revision validator caps at 40 hex:
- candidateStore.ts:41 SHA_RE /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i
- checkRunStore.ts:43, a copy of the same regex
- receiptStore.ts:54 REVISION_RE /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i
- finalizeAttempt.ts:41 REVISION_PATTERN, the same 40
- the wrappers' 40-zero ids (moe-agent.sh:2294, moe-agent.ps1:4034)

In a `git init --object-format=sha256` repository (64-hex ids), a `landed` finalize is refused on each of its 3 tries, the loop stops and the attempt stays finalizing. With a qualityGate, the unrecordable candidate is reported as a gate failure and the bytes are parked on a rescue ref.

Decide one rule when the regexes are unified: either accept 64 hex, or refuse sha256 repositories up front with a clear message. This is rare, and it is filed here rather than as its own task.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 10 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Where the three shared symbols live:
- A new util module (for example util/shapes.ts) or util/sanitize.ts: rejected. A separate home file means 11 distinct files: 8 consumers + the home + the test + CLAUDE.md, which is past the submit_plan hard cap of 10.
- candidateStore.ts (chosen). It already exports SHA_RE, the other Wave 1 stores, deliveryProjection and delivery/policy already import from it, and it has no imports back into them. So it can hold all three symbols with no cycle and no new file.
- Re-exports that leave the allowlists untouched: rejected. They are not a single definition, and they leave no test that fails on the old code.
- A source-scan guard test against re-duplication: rejected. It would change the suite counts, and the DoD requires them unchanged. The grep in the verify step proves the single definitions once instead.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- All 5 renderGot copies are byte-identical (same md5): delivery/policy.ts, candidateStore, checkRunStore, receiptStore and reviewStore.
- The regex copies:
  - SHA_RE /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i: candidateStore (exported), checkRunStore, tools/recordCommit.ts.
  - 40-hex /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i: receiptStore REVISION_RE, finalizeAttempt REVISION_PATTERN.
  - deliveryProjection has an inline /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/i.
- Export allowlist tests exist for candidateStore (it lists SHA_RE and pins its value), checkRunStore and receiptStore. Only candidateStore's changes. reviewStore has no allowlist test.
- stateModules.test.ts forbids runtime import cycles inside src/state.
- The CLAUDE.md line 88 clause 'since `reviewStartedAt`' is the only stale copy of the NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT anchor. The real rule is completionCommitsForReview in delivery/policy.ts: the latest rejection, else workStartedAt, else reviewStartedAt.
planningNotes.risks:
- Serialization: dependsOn is task-fd970f24 (WORKING, edits delivery/policy.ts) and task-fee5e136 (PLANNING, very likely edits deliveryProjection.ts). Start after both land. Their new tests change the suite total, which is why the baseline is taken on this task's own starting commit.
- Count drift: peers' dirty test files in the shared checkout shift counts. Compare on a clean git-archive export, before and after applying this diff.
- CLAUDE.md is one huge shared line, so keep the hunk to the clause.
- Behaviour must not change: keep the regex literals, flags and error messages exactly. Never add a g flag to a shared regex.
- 10 distinct files is exactly the gate's cap. Do not add files, for example by pinning REVISION_RE in receiptStore.test.ts.
